mn-000d.title: Plate: white with red on the left
mn-000d.summary: White plates with a hint of red on the left, from a national symbol printed there.

mn-2TeD.title: Landscape: rare crop fields near the capital
mn-2TeD.summary: Crop fields are rare because of the harsh climate, but appear in two areas near the capital.

mn-2q6G.title: Pole: Russian-style wooden poles on stone blocks
mn-2q6G.summary: Wooden poles propped by stone blocks, white lamp posts and pedestrian signs with three stripes, as in Russia. A stop sign saying ЗОГС is unique. Each town has its own lamp post design.

mn-4wVe.title: Landscape: giant sword statue, flat green land
mn-4wVe.summary: A flat green landscape with low rolling hills and a giant sword statue in the distance, in the far east.

mn-62RZ.title: Google car: tent with 4 straps
mn-62RZ.summary: A tent with four straps covers most of the centre-north.

mn-6YM0.title: Coverage: glaciers and snowy peaks, bag on roof racks
mn-6YM0.summary: Very remote coverage in the far west showing the tallest mountains with glaciers and snow-capped peaks. The car has a green or black bag above the right side roof racks.

mn-7X35.title: Landscape: dark distant hills S and W, wet roads
mn-7X35.summary: A town with dark distant hills to the south and west and low rolling hills to the north and east. Roads are often wet after heavy rain. Older coverage shows a tent inflated on the left.

mn-8IlN.title: Road: extremely snowy and foggy, blue tent
mn-8IlN.summary: A road south of the capital covered during a blizzard: very snowy and foggy, deep blue tent, flat land.

mn-9LhD.title: Road: second desert highway, cloudy, blue tent
mn-9LhD.summary: Another desert highway, told apart from the first by cloudy skies, darker pavement and a deep blue tent on the car instead of no tent.

mn-Ac9z.title: Landscape: narrow forest trails, close trees, birches
mn-Ac9z.summary: A large forest with narrow dirt trails and trees close on both sides, which looks Russian. Birches are very common. These trails are not on the map.

mn-CNFX.title: Landscape: warm green rolling hills, ferris wheel
mn-CNFX.summary: A large central town with a warm, green, grassy landscape in Gen 4 and low rolling hills in every direction. A ferris wheel stands in a park in the centre. Older coverage has a smudge on the right of the camera.

mn-DNBa.title: Language: Cyrillic with extra letters Ө and Ү
mn-DNBa.summary: Mostly Cyrillic script, with Ө and Ү (not in Russian) and many double vowels like aa, ӨӨ, ЭЭ. Latin and the old vertical script appear occasionally. Kyrgyz and Kazakh also use Ө and Ү.

differs.how: Russian has no Ө or Ү

mn-F9MC.title: Landscape: red rocky hills north of a dry shrubby town
mn-F9MC.summary: A large dry, shrubby town in the west, with very distinct rocky, red-tinted hills to the north. Nearby smaller towns look similar.

mn-Fk6T.title: Google car: grey tent with hooks
mn-Fk6T.summary: A grey tent with hooks is only in the west. It is the most common car with the netted spare tyre.

mn-HXZm.title: Pole: sailboat lamp posts with golden flower pot
mn-HXZm.summary: On the southern border town: unique sailboat-shaped lamp posts with a golden flower pot, often with white signs in old vertical script. Two nearby desert towns look similar but use blue or white lamp posts.

mn-HYQF.title: Road: dark freshly paved road in the flat east
mn-HYQF.summary: One of the only paved highways in the east: cloudy, very dark newly laid asphalt, mostly flat land.

mn-IIJa.title: Pole: double lamp posts with blue or green base
mn-IIJa.summary: A north-western town with large, distant dark mountains to the south-west, and double lamp posts with a blue or green base. Two flat eastern towns rarely have double lamp posts too.

mn-IJMM.title: Landmark: decorated stone piles (ovoos)
mn-IJMM.summary: Piles of stones, often decorated, used as ceremonial markers or shrines. Common everywhere.

mn-ITbP.title: Houses: white round yurts
mn-ITbP.summary: White round yurts, the traditional nomad home, are seen all over the country.

mn-IjJW.title: Road: rolling hills, pylons, winter, no tent
mn-IjJW.summary: Low rolling hills, tall power pylons and sometimes crop fields. Most of it is winter coverage with a tentless car, light snow and yellow grass. Summer coverage appears sometimes in the eastern half.

mn-IpnP.title: Landscape: more lakes and rivers in the west
mn-IpnP.summary: Lakes and rivers are much more common in the west.

mn-JXlt.title: Landscape: rocky rugged hills with small trees, clear sky
mn-JXlt.summary: Distinct rocky, rugged hills with small trees to the north, very clear skies, and neighbourhoods visible on the slopes.

mn-JhMx.title: Google car: tent with lower strap bunched up
mn-JhMx.summary: A tent with the lower strap in a clump covers most of the centre-south, along the road from the capital to the far west.

mn-Jkr2.title: Coverage: autumn orange grass and trees
mn-Jkr2.summary: Orange trees and grass from autumn coverage, only in a few areas: mostly in the north between two towns, plus some around the capital. More trees the further north you go. Some newer Gen 4 coverage in the capital was also shot in autumn.

mn-JqMp.title: Landscape: grid town, jagged hill, dark cloudy skies
mn-JqMp.summary: A northern town laid out on a north-south grid with a large jagged hill to the north, dark cloudy skies and muddy unpaved roads. Sunny coverage exists occasionally.

mn-K0eK.title: Coverage: off-road desert tracks
mn-K0eK.summary: Several areas of off-road desert coverage in the south, mostly directly south or east of one central-south town.

mn-KUPP.title: Google car: bright silver tent
mn-KUPP.summary: A bright silver tent is generally in the centre and north-west. One highway there is almost entirely hidden coverage.

mn-LCSK.title: Houses: dirt alleys and wooden fences
mn-LCSK.summary: Neighbourhoods are separated by dirt alleys and wooden fences.

mn-Lu1H.title: Road: small dirt tracks in vast grass fields
mn-Lu1H.summary: In the far east: small dirt tracks through flat, vast grassy fields.

mn-Mm6D.title: Coverage: four areas of night photos
mn-Mm6D.summary: Four main areas have night coverage, all driving towards a town: north-west, west, south and east. Driving direction and the car help tell them apart.

mn-Mp7y.title: Landscape: heavy overcast, dry forested hills
mn-Mp7y.summary: Two neighbouring northern towns near the border with dry forested hills all around and heavy overcast. One is completely overcast, the other a little less. Other overcast towns lack forested hills and use different cars.

mn-N0GU.title: Landscape: green hills around a town, river, symbol hill
mn-N0GU.summary: A west-central town surrounded by large green hills, with many trees and a river through it. A small hill in the centre has a national symbol carved on it.

mn-NJSE.title: Google car: grey tent, no left hooks, billowing
mn-NJSE.summary: A grey tent with no hooks on the left that billows in the wind: on the road between two far-west towns or around a third nearby.

mn-NW0E.title: Plants: larch forests in the north
mn-NW0E.summary: In the north: forests surrounded by grass, mostly Siberian larch, with pines and birches common too.

mn-Oefv.title: Google car: tent with 2 straps, one knot
mn-Oefv.summary: A tent with two straps and one knot covers most of the north-west. Stitching can hide the knot.

mn-QUem.title: Landscape: dense forest, dark soil, grey tent
mn-QUem.summary: A national park in the north-west with some of the densest forests, partly cloudy skies, dark soil and the western grey tent. Its trails are not on the map. You can be fully surrounded by trees here.

mn-R6l0.title: Landscape: bright orange sand and dunes
mn-R6l0.summary: In the far south: bright orange sand and dunes. Two spots: one with distant southern mountains, and one in the far south-west with a Jeep follow car.

mn-RIyc.title: Landscape: flat east and south, hills north, peaks west
mn-RIyc.summary: Very flat in the east and south, rolling hills in the north, and large mountains and rocky hills in the west.

mn-SCt6.title: Google car: silver truck, blue-white roof decal
mn-SCt6.summary: Gen 4 in the capital: a silver truck with an ornate blue and white roof decal, a snorkel and a long antenna at the front right. Sometimes only the snorkel and antenna show. Only around the capital.

mn-SZ7K.title: Coverage: big city with snow
mn-SZ7K.summary: A large northern city with snow coverage and many tall buildings and cars. It is the only large city with snow, apart from some suburbs of the capital.

mn-SagU.title: Google car: silver pickup, big light-blue tent
mn-SagU.summary: Gen 4 in the west: a silver pickup with a big light blue tent. The tent variations help narrow the region.

mn-TGzK.title: Google car: red tent straps in a flat dry town
mn-TGzK.summary: A major eastern town with red straps on the front of the tent, dry, flat, with small hills to the north and somewhat cloudy skies. Two other towns have the same tent but are much smaller with no paved roads.

mn-U3HS.title: Bollard: white bowling pin with two red stripes
mn-U3HS.summary: A white bowling-pin-shaped bollard with two red stripes round the top. Only found here.

mn-UEmk.title: Coverage: driving away from the capital
mn-UEmk.summary: Driving direction is a useful clue: you generally drive away from the capital.

mn-UQH7.title: Google car: grey tent, hook straps point down
mn-UQH7.summary: Grey tent with hook straps angled downwards means the south-west.

mn-VeQ6.title: Google car: cloudy desert town, deep blue tent
mn-VeQ6.summary: A large, notably cloudy desert town with a deep blue tent instead of the tentless car. It is not on the main desert highway.

mn-WGaz.title: Google car: rubber in roof racks = west, empty = east
mn-WGaz.summary: Rubber inlays in the roof racks are mostly in the west; empty racks are mostly in the east. This splits the country in half.

mn-ZHC6.title: Landscape: small shrubs, patchy grass, flat
mn-ZHC6.summary: Many small shrubs and patchy grass in a fairly flat landscape, east of a big western lake. A similar area near another lake is much hillier.

mn-Zafg.title: Google car: cage on the roof, winter
mn-Zafg.summary: A cage instead of a tent, near the capital. West of the capital it has a green camouflage sleeping bag on the cage. All of it is winter, mostly snowy. It rarely appears in two nearby towns.

mn-Znnn.title: Landscape: distinctive hill north-west of the town
mn-Znnn.summary: A distinctive hill north-west of a town in an otherwise flat landscape.

mn-akFr.title: Google car: silver pickup, metal box and shovel
mn-akFr.summary: Gen 4 in the east: a silver pickup with a large metal box and a shovel on the roof. Sponsor lettering is often partly hidden by stitching.

mn-cIAF.title: Animals: big herds of horses, yaks, sheep, camels
mn-cIAF.summary: Large herds of horses, yaks, cows, sheep, goats and camels are very common.

mn-cnjf.title: Coverage: sunset in a dry fall-coloured town
mn-cnjf.summary: Sunset coverage, dry climate, fall-coloured grass, rocky hills to the south, some smoke stacks, and a loose tent cover on the left side.

mn-d8af.title: Google car: spare tyre type splits four zones
mn-d8af.summary: The spare tyre on the back right has four types by area: netted, single strap, no strap, or none at all. See the map.

mn-da1W.title: Road: a couple of paved desert roads
mn-da1W.summary: In the south there are a couple of paved desert roads.

mn-dntg.title: Landscape: treeless grassland steppe or desert
mn-dntg.summary: Steppe: empty grassland or desert with almost no trees, plus rugged rocky or rolling hills, rivers and lakes. Some forest exists but most of the country is open.

mn-g9D1.title: Google car: no tent, near the capital
mn-g9D1.summary: A car with no tent around the capital, usually on a north-west diagonal through it. On the south-east desert road it has a double mirror on the left and a backward snorkel. It always drives away from the capital.

mn-gdTt.title: Google car: tent with open zipper
mn-gdTt.summary: A tent with an open zipper in the centre, near one town.

mn-gz04.title: Google car: tent with a knot on both straps
mn-gz04.summary: A tent with a knot on both straps covers most of the south-west.

mn-hdnu.title: Landscape: dry rugged hills and mountains
mn-hdnu.summary: In the far west: dry, rugged hills and mountains are common.

mn-iKWh.title: Landscape: desert town with dry ridge, mini Eiffel Tower
mn-iKWh.summary: The largest desert town: dry climate, many buildings, paved roads, a dry ridge splitting the town in two, and a small pink Eiffel Tower downtown.

mn-iRdb.title: Pole: wavy lamp posts, red-tinted roads
mn-iRdb.summary: A small hilly town with red-tinted roads and unique wavy-design lamp posts.

mn-l0eQ.title: Landscape: coarse soil, patchy grass, small shrubs
mn-l0eQ.summary: In the south-west: dry steppe with coarse soil, patchy grass and small shrubs.

mn-lm-2587.title: Coverage: sunset into night, driving east
mn-lm-2587.summary: On a north-eastern road the car drives from sunset into night. A similar sunset road in the south-east can be told apart by direction: this one goes east.

mn-lm-3481.title: Google car: tent with two neat straps, no knots
mn-lm-3481.summary: Gen 4 west of one far-west town to about another: the tent is tied with two neat straps and no knots.

mn-lm-3482.title: Google car: two straps with messy knot, zipper far left
mn-lm-3482.summary: Gen 4 between two western towns: two straps with a messy knot, and the zipper tag all the way to the left.

mn-lm-3483.title: Google car: two straps with one messy clump
mn-lm-3483.summary: Gen 4 from the central-west towards a central town: two straps with a messy knot in one clump and no loose loops.

mn-lm-3484.title: Google car: two straps with messy knot and loose loop
mn-lm-3484.summary: Gen 4 from a central town to the capital: two straps with a messy knot that has a loose loop.

mn-lm-3485.title: Google car: four neat straps
mn-lm-3485.summary: Gen 4 north and south of one far-west town: the tent has four neatly packed straps.

mn-lm-3486.title: Google car: open tent with four straps
mn-lm-3486.summary: The zipper of the tent is open on one northern stretch. With four straps visible you are on the eastern part of it.

mn-lm-3487.title: Google car: open tent, four straps meeting at left
mn-lm-3487.summary: Open tent zipper on one northern stretch. Four straps coming together at a point on the left means the north-south part in the middle.

mn-lm-3488.title: Google car: open tent with only two straps
mn-lm-3488.summary: Open tent zipper on one northern stretch. Only two straps visible means the westernmost part.

mn-lm-3489.title: Google car: water bottle in truck bed
mn-lm-3489.summary: A water bottle is visible on the left of the truck bed on one stretch between a far-west lake and a nearby town.

mn-lm-3490.title: Google car: black object in truck bed
mn-lm-3490.summary: On a short stretch of road in the north-west, a black object is visible on the left side of the truck bed.

mn-lm-3491.title: Google car: two knots on the left
mn-lm-3491.summary: In the south-west the tent is usually tied with two straps and two knots on the right. Knots on the left mean one of two specific stretches around one mountain range.

mn-lm-3492.title: Google car: four straps, two knots on the right
mn-lm-3492.summary: Between two north-western towns the tent has four straps with both knots on the right.

mn-lm-3493.title: Google car: single knot slightly right
mn-lm-3493.summary: In the west and north-west the tent usually has two straps and one knot centred or on the left. A knot slightly on the right means one specific road.

mn-lm-3494.title: Google car: four straps, one knot in centre
mn-lm-3494.summary: Around one central town: four straps with one of the two knots in the centre of the tent and the other on the right.

mn-lm-3893.title: Coverage: sunset into night, driving north
mn-lm-3893.summary: In the south-east the car drives past sunset into darkness, with shadows growing long. The other sunset road in the north-east goes east; this one goes north.

mn-lmEn.title: Landscape: big city, ferris wheel, cloudy winter
mn-lmEn.summary: The second biggest city: many tall buildings, a large stadium and a ferris wheel in the south, barren hills to the north and south. Shot on a cloudy winter day, so plants are dead. Similar to two other cities, but no snow and cloudy skies set it apart.

mn-nIEA.title: Coverage: very limited, mostly highways and big towns
mn-nIEA.summary: Coverage is very sparse, mainly highways and large towns, with the most around the capital. Learn which roads have coverage.

mn-niLB.title: Coverage: autumn colours and a big lake
mn-niLB.summary: A small lake town with orange autumn trees and grass, and the large lake to the north-east.

mn-oLiH.title: Road: long desert highway with railway
mn-oLiH.summary: The longest paved road covered: mostly desert with dry brown soil, no plants, clear skies, flat land, and a railway along it (west of the road in the north, east in the south). Some overcast coverage in the middle.

mn-oR6b.title: Landscape: tall building under construction, dry
mn-oR6b.summary: A towering unfinished building in the town centre, with an orange tower crane, and dry land around. Smaller unfinished buildings in other towns have no orange crane.

mn-pIrI.title: Landscape: close dry rocky mountains, red-white tower
mn-pIrI.summary: A large western town surrounded by close, dry, rocky mountains, with a tall red and white radio tower at the south end that is visible across town.

mn-pyL0.title: Houses: big city with high-rises and yurt districts
mn-pyL0.summary: The capital holds about half the population: many high-rises, chain stores, traffic, clean roads. The suburbs are huge yurt districts on hills. Gen 4 is common, with Gen 3 winter coverage in the suburbs.

mn-qNm9.title: Google car: light blue tent, forward snorkel
mn-qNm9.summary: In the eastern grasslands the car has a light blue tent and a snorkel pointing forward.

mn-qUOB.title: Google car: big pickup with tent, red mirrors, snorkel
mn-qUOB.summary: All coverage was shot from a big pickup truck that is often visible: a tent on top, red side mirrors, a raised antenna pipe (snorkel) and roof racks.

mn-rcbr.title: Google car: blue tent, backward-facing snorkel
mn-rcbr.summary: North of the capital: the same blue tent as the east but with a backward-facing snorkel, which can be hard to see. Confirm with rolling hills and forests. One highway there can have either this car or a tentless snowy one.

mn-rqJk.title: Coverage: extremely foggy, dark soil and hills
mn-rqJk.summary: Extremely foggy photos with dark soil and hills, in a valley west of one southern town.

mn-sQ4c.title: Google car: orange roof straps layout
mn-sQ4c.summary: The layout of the orange straps on the roof racks, seen looking straight down, splits the east into smaller areas. Only useful for the eastern blue-tent car, since the west has orange straps too.

mn-sZZF.title: Road: late autumn, orange short grass, silver tent
mn-sZZF.summary: Late autumn coverage with dry orange short grass, a silver tent, clear skies and low rolling hills. The sun sets gradually as you drive west, ending in sunset. At the end the car continues north-west on dirt trails.

mn-soGu.title: Landscape: big dry hill with a symbol carved on it
mn-soGu.summary: A central town with an overall dry landscape and a large dry hill to the east carved with a national symbol. Older coverage has a smudge on the right side of the camera.

mn-tCNu.title: Coverage: rainstorm with dark skies and raindrops
mn-tCNu.summary: A long road stretch driven in a rainstorm: much darker skies, raindrops on the camera, and sometimes a rainbow.

mn-vB6O.title: Coverage: snow around the capital
mn-vB6O.summary: Snowy coverage is mostly around the capital.

mn-vVxd.title: Landscape: concrete roads, smoke stack, wet and overcast
mn-vVxd.summary: The only major city with several concrete roads, a smoke stack in the south-east corner, wet roads and overcast skies. Sometimes a pedestrian sign with a short figure over three stripes.

mn-vYFN.title: Road: railway beside the road, river to the south
mn-vYFN.summary: A railway runs along almost the whole road, usually close but sometimes far off on a raised mound. In the western half a river lies to the south. The railway is not on the map.

mn-wyCn.title: Google car: red tent straps at the front
mn-wyCn.summary: The tent has red tensioner straps at the front around one eastern town. The road to a nearby town is almost entirely hidden coverage.

mn-yu6W.title: Landscape: pebble-covered ground, cliffs, forest
mn-yu6W.summary: A river valley with rocky cliffs and forest, and ground completely covered in pebbles.
